verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM, so custom fields and filtered, sorted, shared views are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack never documents creating custom fields or building or sharing filtered and sorted views. It offers only a generic claim that Salesmate can be customized to business needs, and AI agents updating existing CRM fields is a different capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project
